propositions: The inbound fetcher currently resolves only a single query_project and builds one JQL pair, causing multi-project stores to ingest issues from only one project while silently dropping parent/comment/issuelink enrichment data for other projects
Inbound-created tickets do not record their source project, leaving bridge_project and repos fields unset on tickets from multi-project stores

The fetcher must fan out the JQL pair and all three enrichment passes (parent, comment, issuelink) once per configured project, merging results into a shared snapshot while maintaining per-project truncation ceilings
Inbound CREATE events must stamp bridge_project (derived from jira-key prefix) and repos (from the source project's mapping entry) at the write site via projects_store.resolve_inbound_bridge_fields
Single-project (unseeded-mapping) behavior must remain byte-identical to the pre-change implementation, issuing the same query pair and enrichment pass
Per-project enrichment must apply fail-open degradation independently, while base-query exceptions and pagination stalls propagate to fail the entire pass
